summary: Sagtec Global Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting that its wholly owned Malaysian subsidiary, CL Technologies (International) Sdn. Bhd., changed its corporate name to CLAI Tech Sdn. Bhd. The change was registered in Malaysia under the Companies Act 2016, evidenced by a Certificate of Incorporation on Change of Name dated October 9, 2026. The Company issued a press release on October 13, 2026. The name change does not alter the subsidiary's ownership, management, contractual obligations, or business operations. Sagtec's ordinary shares continue trading on Nasdaq under SAGT. This is a routine corporate administrative filing, not a special situation.
